text: Binary per-row flag from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP): 1 if at least one comment itself offers specific empirical evidence for its own argument, i.e. concrete statistics/data, named studies or sources, documented real-world cases, or specific factual observations/personal experiences. General assertions, opinions, hypotheticals and invented scenarios don't count; outside verification isn't required; evidence merely quoted from the OP as the OP's position doesn't count. Ignore text announcing the OP's view change or delta award, post-outcome thanks/resolution updates, and reports of whether the outcome occurred; generic delta/platform-rule discussion is not an outcome announcement and not evidence. Output 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies (including empty list); null if OC_comments is missing or malformed.
